description: Dashboard Navigation Update - Update the Configure Interview button on the dashboard to link to /interview/setup instead of being disabled. Improve UX by showing different states based on whether user has resume uploaded.
steps: Locate the 'Mock Interview' card (third card in the grid with PlayCircle icon)
Find the button currently showing 'Configure Interview (Stage 7)' with disabled prop

Replace button implementation: if profileData?.hasActiveResume, render Link component wrapping a button styled element with href='/interview/setup', text 'Start Mock Interview', full styling preserved from existing button. Else (no resume), render button (not Link) with disabled=true, show warning icon + text 'Upload Resume First', amber color scheme instead of slate-900
Update button classes for enabled state: keep existing classes but ensure no disabled opacity, add hover:scale-[1.02] transition for better UX
Update button classes for disabled state (no resume): 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 cursor-not-allowed' with AlertCircle icon
Add onClick handler to disabled button: shows toast/alert 'Please upload a resume first to unlock mock interviews' and optionally navigates to /resumes
Test both states: with resume (button enabled and links to setup), without resume (button disabled and shows warning)
Ensure ArrowRight icon stays on enabled button, AlertCircle icon on disabled button
Verify styling consistency with other dashboard cards
acceptance_criteria: Button changes based on profileData?.hasActiveResume state
When resume exists: button links to /interview/setup with text 'Start Mock Interview'
When no resume: button disabled with warning icon and text 'Upload Resume First'
Clicking enabled button navigates to interview setup page
Clicking disabled button shows helpful message
No console errors or navigation issues
verification: Test with resume: verify button is enabled and shows 'Start Mock Interview'
Test without resume: delete all resumes via /resumes page, return to dashboard
Verify button shows 'Upload Resume First' with amber styling
Click disabled button, verify appropriate feedback (toast or alert)
Test on mobile viewport, verify button remains functional and styled correctly
